issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. ring_feats uses only each molecule's own SMILES: no labels, no files, no information from other molecules.
No bug found that would make the result meaningless. The ring-system merge works correctly. The 'fused' count also includes spiro atoms, which is harmless overlap.
Small naming issue: the variable 'et' holds LightGBM predictions. It has no effect on results.

The numbers support rejecting the candidate: 0.3702 against the incumbent's 0.3694 is slightly worse and within noise. The recomputed z of about -0.18 (se = 0.0037 * sqrt(1 + 1/2) = 0.00453) matches the reported -0.160 up to rounding of the inputs.
